meta.title: A duplicate custom savings strategy name is refused
gaps: No dedicated catalog step can independently create and count custom savings strategies; do_on_screen must perform and observe those actions on screen.

steps.note: Open an event create screen where savings configuration is available.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.

args.goal: Open Savings, create and save an existing custom savings strategy named S, record the displayed strategy count, attempt to create another custom savings strategy named S, and stop on the screen showing the refusal message "Savings Strategy Already Present!" with the strategy count unchanged

steps.note: Perform the custom strategy creation and duplicate attempt, observing both the refusal message and unchanged count.
Assert that the expected duplicate-name refusal message is shown.
